title: Thread eight nuts onto a supported bracket
instruction: Fit all eight orange nuts onto the bracket studs. Each must advance at least two complete turns and reach the marked seating band. Leave the bracket on its outline and release all parts.
context: A sustained rotational-assembly prototype with measurable thread advance on a movable fixture.
limitations: Box-segment helical collision surfaces are an unvalidated coarse approximation. Clearance, handedness, friction, crest overlap and two-turn retention need native tests.
The expert plan currently positions nuts; repeated wrist rotation and regrasp control are not calibrated or validated.
RoboDojo Fasten Screws and existing multi-stud tasks create a high novelty risk. Eight fasteners alone is not a substantive distinction.
